blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: JEV decision models pair a language model backbone with a lightweight scoring head to select among natural-language options. Direct selection compares candidate answers within one request, whereas entailment reranking evaluates each candidate in a separate natural language inference (NLI) request over fixed relation options. We examine whether the readout and adaptation choices used for direct selection remain effective for cross-request reranking. We combine a mean-span readout with selective backbone adaptation. Mean-span pooling replaces the option-ending pointer with an average of the contextualized states inside each NLI option, without adding head parameters. Selective adaptation retains low-rank updates in attention and gated DeltaNet projections while removing feed-forward adapters. On MC11, which averages accuracy over eleven reranking configurations from seven sources, selective adaptation improves NeoHorse-1-4B accuracy over the all-module baseline while cutting trainable parameters by more than half, and mean-span pooling yields further consistent gains at the same parameter count.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: JEV models turn a natural-language state into a structured decision that software can act on. Their typed interfaces include Choice , which selects among described options; Noul , which answers a binary question; and Score , which assigns probabilities to ordered levels [ 43 , 26 ] . Open implementations such as NeoHorse-Jev and Kev attach a small bilinear scoring head to an adapted language model backbone [ 41 , 31 ] , encoding the context and options in one forward pass and using the hidden state at each option’s closing delimiter to produce a distribution over the candidates.
blocks.zh: JEV模型将一个自然语言状态转变为一个结构化的决定,软件可以采取行动. 他们的被打入的接口包括选择(Choice),它从描述的选项中选择;诺尔(Noul),它回答一个二进制问题;和分数(Score),它将概率分配到被命令的级别[43,26]. 开放执行如NeoHorse-Jev和Kev将一个小双线分数头附加到一个适应性语言模型主干线上[41,31],将上下文和选项编码在一个前行传中,并使用每个选项的关闭分解器所隐藏的状态来产生对被选者的分布.

blocks.en: These models can answer multiple-choice questions either by comparing all candidate answers within one request (direct selection) or by evaluating each candidate in a separate natural language inference (NLI) request (entailment reranking). Reranking provides a fixed scoring interface for externally supplied answers: their number and wording can vary while the head continues to score entailment, neutral, and contradiction. The question serves as the premise and each candidate answer enters the instruction as a hypothesis; selection then compares entailment probabilities across requests. Because the NLI option text is fixed while its contextualized states vary with the candidate hypothesis, designs suited to comparing answers within one request may be less effective when candidates are scored independently. We therefore combine mean-span pooling over the interior option states with selective backbone adaptation, gathering information from more positions while updating fewer backbone projections.
blocks.zh: 这些模型可以通过比较一个请求(直接选择)中所有候选人的答案,或者通过对每个候选人进行单独的自然语言推断(NLI)请求(尾声重排)的评价,来回答多个选择问题. 重新排序为外部提供的答案提供了一个固定的分数界面:其数量和措辞可能有所不同,而头部则继续得分,中性,和自相矛盾. 这个问题作为前提,每个候选人的回答都作为假设输入指令;然后选择比较各种请求的概率。 由于NLI选项文本是固定的,而其上下文状态与候选假说不同,因此,当候选者独立得分时,适合在一个请求中比较答案的设计可能效果较差. 因此,我们把内部选择状态的平面组合与选择性骨干调整结合起来,从更多位置收集信息,同时更新较少的骨干预测。

blocks.en: The two design choices jointly adjust how option representations are extracted and how they are learned. First, a mean-span readout replaces the option-ending delimiter pointer with the mean of the contextualized states inside each NLI option. Because the bilinear head is affine in the option states under a shared decision query, pooling computes an exact average of pre-softmax token-level scores and distributes the direct scoring gradient across the span without adding head parameters. Second, selective backbone adaptation retains low-rank (LoRA) updates in the attention and gated DeltaNet projections that participate in contextual interaction, removing feed-forward network (FFN) adapters while keeping the pretrained FFN weights in the forward pass. Because the head and adapters shape the option representations together, we evaluate both designs under a common one-epoch, lower-learning-rate recipe that avoids the accuracy loss observed with longer training or higher adapter rates.
blocks.zh: 两种设计选择共同调整如何取出选项表述和如何学习. 首先,中宽读出用每个 NLI 选项内上下文状态的平均值取代了选项终结的分隔符指针. 由于bilinear头在选项中是afine在共享决定查询下表示,集合计算出一个准确的预软马克斯符号级分数的平均值,并在不添加头参数的情况下将直接分数梯度在整个周期内分布. 其次,选择性骨干适应在注意和有门的 DeltaNet 预测中保留了低等(LORA)更新,这些更新参与上下文的交互,去除向导网络(FFN)适配器,同时将预先训练的FFN分量保留在前传. 因为头和适配器共同塑造了选项表达,所以我们评价两种设计都是在一个共同的划时代,低学习率的配方下,避免了随着更长时间的训练或更高的适配器率观察到的精度损失.

blocks.en: Our experiments on NeoHorse-1-4B show that the scoring interface changes the relative performance of option readouts, while reducing adaptation capacity can improve reranking accuracy. With checkpoints and questions held fixed on PIQA and SocialIQA, the pointer leads on average under direct selection, while pooling leads under entailment reranking. On the eleven-configuration MC11 benchmark, the one-epoch, lower-rate recipe establishes an all-module pointer reference at 50.28% accuracy. Selective adaptation raises this to 52.49% while reducing trainable parameters by 55.2% (from 131.2M to 58.8M), and adding mean-span pooling lifts accuracy further to 53.39% at the same parameter count. Both steps improve MC11 across all four fold–seed settings. Under all-module adaptation, mean-span pooling (51.00%) also outperforms a pointer at the final content token (49.11%). The individual design choices also improve PIQA and CommonsenseQA reranking, whereas the combined model loses accuracy on the JevBench and Kev direct-decision suites.
blocks.zh: 我们在NeoHorse-1-4B上的实验显示,评分接口改变了选项读取的相对性能,同时降低适应能力可以提高再排级的准确性. 由于检查站和问题被固定在PIQA和SocialIQA上,指针平均在直接选择下领先,同时将线索集中在重新排序下。 在11个配置的MC11基准上,一个时代,更低的配方以50.28%的精度建立了全模块指针参考. 选择性适应将这一比率提高到52.49%,同时将可训练参数减少55.2%(从131.2M降至58.8M),并在相同的参数计数中将平均相接升力精度进一步提高到53.39%. 两个步骤都改善了所有四个折叠-种子设置的MC11. 在全模块适应下,平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平 个人设计选择也改进了PIQA和CommonsenseQA的重排,而综合模型则会失去Jev Bench和Kev直接决定套房的精度.

blocks.en: 2.3 Selective adaptation
blocks.zh: 2.3 选择性适应

blocks.en: We jointly train the decision head and LoRA adapters [ 18 ] , comparing two scopes: all-module adaptation covers attention, gated DeltaNet, and feed-forward network (FFN) projections, whereas selective adaptation (no-FFN) retains adapters only in attention and DeltaNet. Both configurations keep every pretrained FFN layer in the forward computation. Crossing these scopes with the pointer and mean-span readouts lets us compare the readout choices under both forms of adaptation while keeping head size and adapter rank fixed.
blocks.zh: 我们联合培训决策主管和LORA适配器[18],比较了两个范围:全模块适配器覆盖注意,Gated DeltaNet,以及forward网络(FFN)预测,而选择性适配器(no-FFN)只保留了注意和DeltaNet. 两种配置都保留了前期计算中每个预训FFN层. 与指针和中宽读取相交叉,让我们可以比较两种适应形式的读取选择,同时保持头大小和适配器的分级不变.

blocks.en: At inference, pooling averages hidden states already produced by the backbone before applying the key projection (Equation 6 ). Each option therefore requires one projected key, and reranking continues to use one backbone request per answer. Selective adaptation reduces the parameters requiring gradients and optimizer states during training, while the pretrained backbone remains intact.
blocks.zh: 推论,在应用密钥投影之前,集合主干线已经产生的被隐藏的状态(方程式6. 因此,每个选项都需要一个预测的钥匙,重新排序时继续使用每个答案一个主干请求。 选择性的适应降低了训练期间需要梯度和优化状态的参数,而预训骨干则保持完好.

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: Our main experiments use NeoHorse-1-4B [ 30 ] , a post-trained, text-only repackaging of Qwen3.5-4B whose backbone combines attention and gated DeltaNet layers [ 49 ] . The reference recipe trains the decision head and rank-64 adapters jointly for one epoch with a OneCycle schedule [ 37 ] , using a peak learning rate of × 10 − 5 1.25\!\times\!10^{-5} for both parameter groups. The learning-rate diagnostics also test × 10 − 5 2.5\!\times\!10^{-5} , and all comparisons evaluate the final weights of each run. A separate pointer–pooling comparison on Qwen3-4B [ 48 ] examines the readout change with another backbone.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要实验使用NeoHorse-1-4B [30],这是经过后训练的,只使用文字的再包装了Quen3.5-4B,其骨干结合了注意力和有门的DeltaNet地层[49]. 参考食谱对决定头和六十四级适配器进行联合训练,在一个有"一环"时间表的时代[37],使用两个参数组的峰值学习率为×10−5 1.25\!times\!10\-5}. 学习率诊断也测试了×10 − 5 2.5\!\times\!10×5},所有比较都评价了每次跑跑的最后分量. 在Quen3-4B [48] 上进行单独指针-集合比较,与另一个主干检查读取变化.

blocks.en: The training mixture combines web decisions and policy tasks with sentiment, topic, intent, and entailment classification. Public-source labels and model-generated reference answers are converted to a shared request format while retaining each question’s native options and target distribution. MC11 reuses the scorer learned from this mixture: each candidate answer becomes a separate NLI request, and its entailment probability determines its rank among the candidates.
blocks.zh: 培训混合将网络决定和政策任务与情绪、主题、意图和必然的分类结合起来。 公用源标签和模型生成的参考答案被转换为共享请求格式,同时保留每个问题的本地选项和目标分布. MC11重用从这种混合体中吸取的分数器:每个考生的回答成为单独的NLI请求,其产生概率决定其在考生中的排名.

blocks.en: To keep related records together, we assign whole groups to splits before forming eight training pools, which contain 17,661 records and 24,001 questions. Each fold trains on seven pools; crossing two folds with two random seeds gives four matched settings. Within a setting, each configuration is trained afresh with compatible initial tensors, data order, and augmentation streams matched across the comparison. The learning-rate, scope, and budget studies reuse the same lower-rate, one-epoch reference pointers, giving their contrasts a common reference within each setting. Appendix A gives the grouping rules, augmentation procedure, and complete training configuration.
blocks.zh: 为了保持相关记录,我们在组成8个培训人才库之前,分配各小组进行分批,其中包括17 661个记录和24 001个问题。 每个折叠列车在7个水池上运行;通过2个折叠并带有2个随机种子,给出了4个相匹配的设置. 在一种环境下,每个配置都经过了新的培训,具有兼容的初始分数、数据顺序和通过比较匹配的增强流。 学习率,范围,和预算研究重用同样的低分率,一地的参考指针,给出了它们在每个设置中的共同参考. 附 录 A给出了分组规则,增强程序和完整的培训配置.

blocks.en: MC11 averages candidate-reranking accuracy across ARC-Easy and ARC-Challenge [ 10 ] ; four- and ten-option GSM8K [ 11 ] ; GPQA and MMLU with and without demonstrations [ 33 , 16 ] ; HellaSwag [ 51 ] ; WinoGrande [ 35 ] ; and synthetic chess. Each configuration receives equal weight and scores its candidates through Equation 1 . The paired configurations of GSM8K, GPQA, and MMLU reuse their respective question populations, changing the candidate count or demonstration context.
blocks.zh: MC11在ARC-Easy和ARC-Challenge之间平均排位精确度为"10";4-和10-可选GSM8K [11];GPQA和MMLU有和无演示[33,16];HelaSwag [51];WinoGrande [35];和合成围棋. 每个配置获得同等分量,并通过方程式1评分其候选人. GSM8K,GPQA和MMLU的配对配置重新使用各自的问题组,改变了候选数或演示上下文.

blocks.en: Candidate construction preserves the supplied answers for multiple-choice tasks. GSM8K pairs the numerical answer with three or nine generated distractors; synthetic chess pairs one legal move with three illegal moves. WinoGrande fills the sentence gap, and HellaSwag uses the candidate ending as the NLI hypothesis.
blocks.zh: 候选建筑保留了为多个选择任务提供的答案. GSM8K用三到九个生成的分心器来配对数值答案;合成棋子配对以三个非法动作来配一合法动作. 维诺格朗德填补了句子的空白,而赫拉斯瓦格则将"候选者"作为结束作为NLI假说.

blocks.en: The additional reranking evaluations use PIQA and CommonsenseQA [ 6 , 39 ] ; fixed-checkpoint PIQA and SocialIQA tests compare both interfaces on the same questions [ 36 ] . JevBench equally averages 18 direct-decision families over 231 questions [ 3 ] . Kev equally averages six development/test selections from its decision suite and two transfer suites [ 31 ] .
blocks.zh: 附加的再排序评价使用PIQA和CommonsenseQA[6,39];固定检查点PIQA和SocialIQA测试在相同问题上比较两个接口[36]. Jev Bench同样平均有18个直接决策家庭超过231个问题[3]. Kev同样平均从其决策套房和两个调用套房中选择了6个开发/测试套房[31].

blocks.en: We report accuracy in percent and paired changes in percentage points (pp). For each contrast, we first calculate the difference within each of the four settings and then report its mean and descriptive SE; SEs for absolute accuracy are calculated directly from the four model scores. These SEs summarize variation across settings that share training pools and evaluation questions. Appendix D examines sensitivity to source weighting, omission of individual sources, and repetition of the reference run.
blocks.zh: 我们以百分比报告准确性,并在百分点上进行配对变化(下页)。 对于每个对比,我们首先计算出四个设置中每个设置的相差,然后报告它的平均值和描述性SE;SE的绝对精确度直接从四个模型分数中计算出. 这些环境组织总结了不同环境的差异,这些环境共享培训人才库和评价问题。 附 录 D审查了对源加权的敏感性、对单个源的省略以及重复参考运行。

blocks.en: 4 Readout Behavior Across Decision Interfaces
blocks.zh: 4 跨越决策界面的读取行为

blocks.en: We compare pointer and pooling models under both request interfaces to test whether the relative performance of the readouts changes with how answers are scored. Each checkpoint is held fixed across interfaces, and both interfaces use the same PIQA and SocialIQA questions. PIQA contains 1,838 validation questions and uses eight higher-rate checkpoints. SocialIQA contains 1,954 development questions and uses eight checkpoints at each of two training budgets.
blocks.zh: 我们比较两个请求界面下的指针和集合模型,以测试读取的相对性能是否与答案的得分方式相去甚远. 每个检查站被固定在跨接口上,两个接口都使用相同的PIQA和SocialIQA问题. PIQA包含1,838个验证问题,并使用8个较高费率的检查站. SocialIQA包含1,954个发展问题,并在两个培训预算中各使用8个检查站.

blocks.en: Table 1: The request interface changes the readout comparison on the same questions and fixed checkpoints. Accuracies are four-setting means; differences include descriptive SEs. Neither source enters MC11.
blocks.zh: 表1:请求界面更改了相同问题和固定检查站的读出比较。 特权是四种设定手段;差异包括描述性SE. 两个消息来源都没有进入MC11.

blocks.en: On PIQA, the readouts are nearly tied under direct selection, whereas pooling leads the pointer under reranking: the relative difference moves from − 0.12 -0.12 to + 8.07 +8.07 pp (Table 1 ). SocialIQA shows the same direction of interface interaction at both budgets, with a positive interaction in every setting. Direct selection has higher mean absolute accuracy on both sources; within reranking, pooling becomes the stronger readout on average.
blocks.zh: 在PIQA上,读取内容几乎被绑在直接选择之下,而集合则在重新排列下引导指针:相对差从−0.12-0.12到+8.07+8.07 pp(表1). SocialIQA在两个预算中都显示出相同的界面互动方向,每个场合都有积极的互动. 直接选择在两个来源中均具有较高的绝对精度;在重新排位内,集合平均成为更强的读出.

blocks.en: The readout comparison also depends on the NLI option wording. Across 18 combinations of three descriptions and six label orders on PIQA, pooling’s mean advantage is + 3.18 ± 3.27 +3.18\pm 3.27 pp; one description set instead favors the pointer by 1.80 pp after averaging over orders (Appendix B.4 ).
blocks.zh: 读出比较还取决于NLI选项措辞. 在PIQA上的3个描述和6个标签订单的18个组合中,集合的平均优势是+ 3.18 ± 3.27 + 3.18\pm 3.27 pp;一种描述在平均比订单多出1.80 pp之后更倾向于指针(附录B.4)。

blocks.en: 5 Reranking Accuracy and Parameter Efficiency
blocks.zh: 5 调整精确度和参数效率

blocks.en: The core comparisons use the same one-epoch recipe, with peak learning rates of × 10 − 5 1.25\!\times\!10^{-5} for both the head and adapters and adapter rank 64. We first examine the combined design, then use controls on adapter allocation, readout, and training to explain the choices.
blocks.zh: 核心比较使用相同的一时制食谱,最高学习率为×10−5 1.25\!\times\!10{5},对头和适配器和适配器均排名为64. 我们首先审查综合设计,然后对适配器的分配、读取和培训使用控制来解释选择。

blocks.en: 5.1 Combining Selective Adaptation and Span Pooling
blocks.zh: 5.1 结合有选择的适应和组合

blocks.en: Combining the two choices gives the highest MC11 accuracy among the four matched configurations, with less than half the trainable parameters of the all-module models (Table 2 ). Starting from the all-module pointer at 50.28%, removing FFN adapters raises accuracy to 52.49%, a paired gain of 2.21 ± 0.66 2.21\pm 0.66 pp. Mean-span pooling then raises it to 53.39% at the same parameter count, adding 0.91 ± 0.35 0.91\pm 0.35 pp. Both steps improve MC11 in every fold–seed setting. Removing FFN adapters reduces trainable parameters from 131.17M to 58.82M, a 55.2% reduction (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 将两个选择组合起来,在四个匹配的配置中给出了最高的MC11精确度,全模模型的可列车参数不到一半(表2. 从50.28%的全模指针开始,移除FFN适配器的精度提升到52.49%,双相增益为2.21±0.66 2.21\pm 0.66pp. 平均相扑集在同一个参数计数下提升到53.39%,增加了0.91±0.350.91\pm 0.35pp. 两个步骤都改善了每个相扑-种子设置的MC11. 拆除FFN适配器可将可受训练参数从131.17M减少到58.82M,减少55.2%(表3)。

Accuracies and paired changes are four-setting means with descriptive SEs. Both readouts have the same parameter count within each scope.
blocks.zh: 表 2: MC11 精度(%)和可训练参数计算核心读取量逐一比较. 所有四个型号都使用一个时代,较低的头和适配器率,以及64级. 精度和配对变化是带有描述性SE的四设定手段. 两种读取法在每个范围内都有相同的参数计数.

blocks.en: Table 3: Trainable parameters in millions at rank 64, rounded independently. The pretrained backbone weights are frozen. Both readouts use the same bilinear head.
blocks.zh: 表3:64级可训练参数以百万计,独立四舍五入. 被预训骨干重量被冻结. 两种读取都使用同一种双线头.

blocks.en: The final combination gains about 3.1 pp over the reference pointer. Its readout-by-scope interaction is small ( + 0.18 ± 0.74 +0.18\pm 0.74 pp), consistent with approximately additive gains from span aggregation and scope restriction.
blocks.zh: 最后的组合增益相较于参考指针约3.1pp. 其逐镜读取的相互作用较小(+0.18±0.74+0.18\pm 0.74pp),与从跨距聚合和范围限制中获得的大约添加增益一致.

blocks.en: 5.2 Adapter Scope and Parameter Budget
blocks.zh: 5.2 适应器范围和参数预算

blocks.en: FFN adapters account for 72.35M trainable parameters, more than half of the all-module adapter budget. Removing them improves the pointer by 2.21 ± 0.66 2.21\pm 0.66 pp and the pooling model by 2.39 ± 0.35 2.39\pm 0.35 pp, showing that the scope change helps with either readout.
blocks.zh: FFN适配器占了72.35M可列车参数,占了全模块适配器预算的一半以上. 删除它们可以使指针改进 2.21 ± 0.66 2.21\pm 0.66 pp,集合模型改进 2.39 ± 0.35 2.39\pm 0.35 pp,显示范围变化有助于任一读出.

blocks.en: A similar parameter budget can instead be distributed across all projections at a lower rank. The all-module rank-28 pointer uses 58.12M trainable parameters and reaches 52.40%, close to the no-FFN rank-64 pointer’s 52.49%. Both allocations improve over the larger all-module reference. The no-FFN allocation uses the smaller budget while retaining rank 64 in attention and DeltaNet, and combines with pooling to give the strongest configuration in Table 2 .
blocks.zh: 相反,类似的参数预算可在所有预测中以较低级别分配。 全模级-28指针采用58.12M可列车参数并达到 52.40%,接近无福尔摩斯级-64指针的 52.49%. 这两项拨款都比较大的全单元参考有所改进。 无福网的分配使用较小的预算,同时保留在关注和DeltaNet的第64名,并与集合相结合,在表2中给出最强的配置。

blocks.en: 5.3 Option Aggregation and Scoring Head
blocks.zh: 5.3 选项聚合和分红头

blocks.en: To examine the role of aggregation, we compare mean-span pooling with a different single-token position and a larger scoring head. The last-content control reads the final token inside each option, retaining the same bilinear head and all-module training recipe. It reaches 49.11% MC11, below both the option-ending pointer and mean-span pooling at 51.00%. Pooling exceeds this control by 1.89 ± 0.97 1.89\pm 0.97 pp, supporting aggregation across the span over either tested pointer position. The largest gains over last-content occur on HellaSwag (8.10 pp) and the two ARC tasks; Appendix B gives the complete task profile.

Under this recipe, the residual branch provides little additional benefit, so the final design retains the bilinear head and changes the option representation supplied to it. blocks.en: 5.4 Training Recipe and Reference Quality
blocks.zh: 5.4 培训手段和参考质量

blocks.en: Because the head and adapters are trained jointly, the reference model’s quality depends on how strongly the backbone is updated. We vary the head and adapter learning rates independently and compare one- and two-epoch schedules, keeping the all-module, rank-64 architecture fixed.
blocks.zh: 由于头和适配器是联合训练的,参考模型的质量取决于主干线更新的力度. 我们独立地改变头部和适配器的学习率,并比较一个和两个时段的进度表,保持全单元,等级-64架构的固定.

blocks.en: 5.5 Task-Level Sources of Improvement
blocks.zh: 5.5 任务级改进来源

blocks.en: HellaSwag and synthetic chess account for most of the net MC11 gain (Figure 3 ). On HellaSwag, pooling adds about 4.2 pp under either adapter scope, while removing FFN adapters adds about 9.1 pp with either readout, giving the final model an advantage of about 13.3 pp. On chess, the pooling gain grows from 1.95 pp under all-module adaptation to 7.35 pp without FFN adapters.

blocks.en: The final model also improves both ARC configurations, both MMLU configurations, and WinoGrande, alongside declines on GSM8K and GPQA. Appendix B gives the component contrasts for every task. The mean pooling and scope gains remain positive under both weighting schemes when any one source is omitted (Appendix D ).

blocks.en: 6 Additional Reranking Sources and Backbone Comparison
blocks.zh: 6 额外的重排源和后骨比较

blocks.en: 6.1 PIQA and CommonsenseQA
blocks.zh: 6.1 PIQA和常识QA

blocks.en: We test the individual design choices beyond MC11 on PIQA and CommonsenseQA. PIQA asks the model to select between two solutions to a physical goal, whereas CommonsenseQA offers five candidate answers. We apply the same three-option NLI scorer to their 1,838 and 1,221 questions, respectively, using separate matched model groups to compare learning rates, readouts, and adapter scope (Table 5 ).
blocks.zh: 我们在PIQA和CommonsenseQA上测试MC11以外的个人设计选择. PIQA要求模型在两个解决方案中选择一个物理目标,而CommonsenseQA则提供五个候选答案. 我们分别对其1,838个和1,221个问题使用相同的三选项NLI分数器,使用不同的匹配的模型组来比较学习率、读取率和适配率范围(表5)。

blocks.en: Table 5: Additional-source support for individual design choices. Changes are paired four-setting means with descriptive SEs. The learning-rate comparison changes head and adapter rates together; the readout comparison uses the same model group. Adapter scope is tested separately with lower-rate, one-epoch pointers and matched initializations. These groups are separate from the core readout-by-scope models in Table 2 ; the final no-FFN pooling model has not been evaluated on these sources.

blocks.en: Lowering both learning rates strengthens the pointer on both sources, and pooling improves these lower-rate models by a further 1.26 pp on PIQA and 4.01 pp on CommonsenseQA. The separate scope comparison follows the same direction: omitting FFN adapters improves both sources in every setting, reaching 80.25% and 63.80%, respectively.
blocks.zh: 降低两种学习率都加强了两个来源的指针,而集合则通过在PIQA和4.01 pp上的CommonsenseQA的再1.26页改进了这些低分率模型. 单独的范围比较遵循同一方向:省略FFN适配器在每一个场合都会改善两个来源,分别达到80.25%和63.80%.

blocks.en: 6.2 Readout on Qwen3-4B
blocks.zh: 6.2 在Quen3-4B上读出

blocks.en: The Qwen3-4B comparison tests the readout change under lower-rate, all-module adaptation. Pooling improves HellaSwag by 3.91 pp, close to the 4.23 pp gain on NeoHorse, and also improves the ARC configurations. Declines elsewhere, including a 4.28 pp loss on four-option GSM8K, outweigh these gains: overall MC11 accuracy is 51.70% for pooling and 52.17% for the pointer. The readout change thus retains gains on particular tasks without improving aggregate accuracy on this backbone. Appendix B reports the complete task comparison.
blocks.zh: Quen3-4B比较测试了在更低速率,全模块适应下读出的变化. Pooling以3.91pp改进了HelaSwag,接近于NeoHorse上的4.23pp增益,也改进了ARC配置. 其他地方的下降,包括四可选择的GSM8K的4.28页损失,超过了这些收益:总的MC11精确度为集合率为51.70%,指针为52.17%. 因此,读出变化保留了特定任务的收益,而没有提高这一主干网的总准确性。 附 录 B报告了完整的任务比较。

blocks.en: 7 Trade-offs on Direct Selection
blocks.zh: 7 关于直接选择的取舍

blocks.en: We also test the same core checkpoints under direct selection to see how the reranking choices affect their original use (Table 6 ). The no-FFN pointer raises MC11 while maintaining JevBench accuracy, at 77.52% versus 77.11% for the all-module pointer. Adding pooling improves MC11 further, with JevBench and Kev accuracies of 73.79% and 78.12%. These are 3.32 and 3.25 pp below the all-module pointer.
blocks.zh: 我们还对直接选择的同一核心检查站进行测试,看看重新排序的选择如何影响其最初的使用(表6)。 无FFN指针在保持Jev Bench精度的同时会提高MC11,全模指针的精度为77.52%与77.11%. 加入集合可进一步提高MC11,而Jev Bench和Kev的速率分别为73.79%和78.12%. 这些是全模指针下方的3.32和3.25pp.

blocks.en: Across both adapter scopes, the pointer gives higher direct-selection accuracy than pooling on these suites. Kev’s declines include decision-test as well as the transfer subsets; Appendix B gives the six-subset profile. Together with the fixed-checkpoint interface comparisons in Section 4 , these results support choosing the readout with the intended scoring task in mind.
blocks.zh: 在两个适配器瞄准镜上,指针给出的直选精度比集中在这些套房上要高. Kev的下降包括决策测试以及转移子集;附录B给出了六子集的剖面. 连同第4节中的固定检查点接口比较,这些结果支持选择读出,同时牢记预定的评分任务。

blocks.en: 8 Related Work
blocks.zh: 8 相关工作

blocks.en: Studies of specialized JEV decision models report uneven performance across knowledge, reasoning, and multilingual tasks [ 24 ] . Interventions on labels, definitions, and context also change their behavior without changing model weights [ 1 , 47 ] . LLM-as-Jev examines joint suffix scoring without training and fine-tuning with KL anchors [ 25 ] . Related work on prompted language models shows that multiple-choice scores depend on the scoring interface and option identifiers [ 34 , 53 ] . We focus on improving the trained JEV model when it is used to compare candidate answers through separate entailment requests.
blocks.zh: 对专业的JEV决定模型的研究表明,各种知识、推理和多语种任务的业绩参差不齐[24]。 关于标签,定义和上下文的干预也会改变他们的行为,而不改变模型权重[1,47]. LLM-as-Jev在不经过培训的情况下检查联合后缀得分,并与KL主播进行微调[25]. 关于被激发语言模型的相关工作显示,多选择分数取决于评分界面和选项标识符[34,53]. 我们的重点是改进训练有素的JEV模型,如果它被用来通过单独的申请来比较候选人的答复。

blocks.en: Pointer and biaffine architectures score contextual representations with shared projections [ 44 , 14 ] . Research on sentence and span representations examines which token states to aggregate [ 32 , 42 ] ; recent work extends these choices to language models used as text encoders [ 45 , 2 ] . Tang and Yang [40] compare pooling and attention while holding the embedding model’s data and backbone fixed. Our comparisons examine option-span readouts trained jointly with adapters, including whether pooling remains useful under a smaller adapter scope.
blocks.zh: 指向和双臂结构以共享预测来评分背景表现[44,14]. 关于句子和跨度表示的研究研究了哪一种符号状态可以汇总[32,42];最近的工作将这些选择扩展到作为文本编码器的语言模型[45,2]. Tang and Yang [40] 在固定嵌入模型的数据和主干时比较集合和关注. 我们的比较审查与适配器联合培训的选项宽读取,包括在较小的适配器范围内集合是否仍然有用。

blocks.en: LoRA restricts adaptation through low-rank updates to selected projections [ 18 ] . Module selection under distribution shift [ 22 ] , forgetting during adaptation [ 5 ] , and learning rates across adapter factors and ranks [ 15 , 8 ] provide reasons to examine placement, capacity, and optimization together. Gradual unfreezing [ 17 ] , head fitting before fine-tuning [ 20 ] , and parameter-efficient head fitting [ 50 ] offer other ways to control adaptation. Fine-tuning stability also depends on initialization, data order, and optimization [ 13 , 29 ] . Our paired comparisons bring readout design and adaptation scope together in a typed decision model used for cross-request entailment reranking.
blocks.zh: LoRA通过低级更新来限制对所选预测的适应[18]. 分配转变中的模块选择[22],在适应过程中忘记[5],以及适应因素和排名的学习率[15,8],为共同审查安置、能力和优化提供了理由。 逐渐解冻 [17],在微调前先装头 [20],而参数高效接头 [50] 提供了控制适应的其他方法. 微调稳定性还取决于初始化,数据顺序,以及优化[13,29]. 我们的对等比较将读出设计和适应范围放在一个用于交叉请求的决定模型中,从而需要重新排序。

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en: Fixed-checkpoint comparisons show that direct selection and entailment reranking can favor different option readouts, indicating that design choices for single-request selection need not transfer unchanged to cross-request reranking. Motivated by this observation, we pair mean-span pooling over each NLI option with selective backbone adaptation restricted to attention and DeltaNet projections, jointly adjusting how option states are extracted and how the backbone is updated. Matched comparisons under a tuned one-epoch recipe establish the gains from both choices, while pointer-position, parameter-budget, and head-capacity controls clarify their respective contributions.
blocks.zh: 固定检查点比较显示,直接选择和要求重新排序可能有利于不同的选项读取,表明单一请求选择的设计选择不需要不变地转移,以便交叉请求重新排序. 基于这一观察,我们将每个NLI选项的中宽组合与选择性的骨干调整限制在注意力和DeltaNet预测上,共同调整选择状态的提取方式和骨干更新方式。 在一个划一的处方下进行匹配的比较可以确定从两个选择中获得的收益,而指向位置、参数-预算和头能力控制则明确了各自的贡献。

blocks.en: On NeoHorse-1-4B, selective adaptation improves MC11 from 50.28% to 52.49%, and adding mean-span pooling reaches 53.39%, with both steps positive in all four fold–seed settings. Together, these changes improve reranking accuracy by about 3.1 pp while reducing trainable parameters by 55.2%.
blocks.zh: 在NeoHorse-1-4B上,选择性的适应改进了MC11,从50.28%提高到52.49%,而增加的平平相聚则达到了53.39%,在所有四个折叠-种子环境中,这两个步骤都是积极的。 这些变化加起来提高了约3.1pp的再排精度,同时将可训练参数减少了55.2%.

blocks.en: A.2 Training corpus and grouped folds
blocks.zh: A.2 培训大纲和组合组合

blocks.en: The predominantly English corpus contains 22,035 records and 29,897 questions drawn from web decisions, policy tasks, and public classification datasets. It combines 4,642 JevForge/Mind2Web records [ 12 ] , 2,676 Nimble records [ 4 ] , 1,680 compositional-policy records, ten public-source groups of 1,000 records each, and generated policy, date, insufficient-evidence, control, and assertion records. The ten public sources are Yelp full-star reviews, DBpedia14, and AG News [ 52 ] ; Banking77 [ 7 ] ; TREC [ 23 ] ; MultiNLI [ 46 ] ; IMDb [ 28 ] ; sentence-level SST-5 [ 38 ] ; BoolQ [ 9 ] ; and the SetFit English packaging of MARC [ 19 ] , with all source labels converted to the shared decision schema.
blocks.zh: 以英文为主的汇编载有22 035个记录和29 897个问题,这些问题取自网络决定、政策任务和公共分类数据集。 它合并了4,642个JevForge/Mind2Web记录[12],2,676个Nimble记录[4],1,680个组成政策记录,10个公共来源的每组记录有1,000个,并产生了政策,日期,证据不足,控制和断言记录. 10个公共来源有:Yelp全明星评论 DBpedia14和AG News [52]; Banking 77 [7]; TREC [23]; MultiNLI [46]; IMDb [28]; 句子级 SST-5 [38]; BoulQ [9]; 和 SetFit English包装 MARC [19],所有源标签被转换为共同决定的 schema.

blocks.en: JevForge uses the cleaned Mind2Web resource at revision 080a4b67 and the JevForge conversion at revision 8c6fa6c9 . The conversion preserves labels and distributions, including probability mass shared by several positive candidates. Its website partition differs from the official Mind2Web out-of-distribution split. The retained Nimble reference is revision f136b3f75721fda4ea961f73993cc50b08488835 . Its publisher describes the reference answers as synthetic and model-checked. Training consumes record contents directly without opening external private-file or image references.
blocks.zh: JevForge在080a4b67修订版使用被清理的Mind2Web资源,在8c6fa6c9修订版使用JevForge转换. 转换保存了标签和分布,包括几个正候选人共享的概率质量. 其网站分区不同于官方的Mind2Web出放分拆. 所保留的"尼姆布尔"参考文献为修订版f136b3f75721fda4ea961f73993cc50b08488835. 其出版商将参考答案描述为被合成和模型检查. 培训直接使用记录内容,而不打开外部的私人文件或图像参考。

blocks.en: To keep related examples in the same split, we link records through shared families, paired or control examples, upstream rows, websites, and normalized states, then assign each connected group as a whole. This produces 12,472 groups, allocated with approximate feature balance: 80% to eight training pools, 5% to locked development, 5% to calibration, and 10% to a separate test split. The eight pools contain 17,661 records and 24,001 questions, with fold j j holding out pool j j and training on the remaining seven. Our four settings combine folds 2 and 3 with seeds 44 and 45: fold 2 contains 15,456 training records and requires 1,932 updates per epoch, while fold 3 contains 15,442 records and requires 1,931 updates.
blocks.zh: 为了将相关实例保留在同一拆分中,我们通过共享家族,对等或控制实例,上游行,网站,以及正常化状态,将记录链接起来,然后将每个被连接的组整体指定. 这产生了12 472个团体,分配的特征大致平衡:80%到8个培训池,5%到锁定开发,5%到校准,10%到单独的测试分拆。 8个游泳池载有17 661个记录和24 001个问题,其中折叠式j j 保留了游泳池 j ,其余7个培训。 我们的四个设置结合了折叠2和3与种子44和45:折叠2包含15,456个训练记录,每个时代需要1,932个更新;而折叠3包含15,442个记录并需要1,931个更新.

blocks.en: The corpus contains 12,486 Choice, 12,176 binary, and 5,235 Score questions. Most supplied target distributions are one-hot (9,142 of 9,457), while the remaining distributions express insufficient evidence through 173 uniform targets or multiple valid solutions through 142 JevForge targets. Training preserves these distributions and augments compatible requests by shuffling options or adding distractor and none-of-the-above options, with augmentation probabilities ranging from 0.10 to 0.25.
blocks.zh: 教程包含12,486个选择,12,176个二进制和5,235个分数问题. 大多数提供的目标分配是一热(9,457分中为9,142分),而其余的分配则通过173个统一目标或通过142个JevForge目标来表达不充分的证据. 训练通过打乱选项或添加分心器和无上选项来保留这些分布并增强相容请求,增强概率从0.10到0.25不等.

blocks.en: A.3 Serialization, backbone, and optimization
blocks.zh: A.3 序列化、骨干和优化

blocks.en: The request format follows NeoHorse-Jev’s option-conditioned implementation of typed JEV decisions [ 43 , 41 ] . A record contains a state and one or more questions, each with an instruction, a type, and option descriptions or ordered levels. The encoder places the state after <|fim_prefix|> , the instruction after <|fim_middle|> , each option between <|box_start|> and <|box_end|> , and a final <|fim_suffix|> . Text segments are tokenized separately without added special tokens; delimiter IDs are inserted explicitly, with no intervening spaces or newlines. The instruction precedes all option tokens. Option isolation is disabled, allowing an option to attend to earlier options in its request.
blocks.zh: 请求格式沿用了NeoHorse-Jev在选择条件下执行JEV[43,41]号决定。 记录包含一个状态和一个或几个问题,每个问题都有指令,类型,以及选项描述或命令级别. 编码器将状态置于 QQfim_prefix 后方, 指令位于 QQfim_middle 后方, 每个选项在 QQbox_start 和 QQbox_end 后方 之间, 以及最后的 QQFim_ sindix 后方 。 文本片段单独标出,不添加特殊符号;明确插入了分隔符ID,没有间隙或新行. 指令在所有选项符号之前 。 选项隔离被禁用,允许选项在请求中处理更早的选项.

blocks.en: Training packs up to 4,096 tokens, with a 2,048-token limit on each state or branch segment; the inference server permits 8,192 tokens and rejects longer requests. Target distributions index Choice options, false/true answers, or Score levels, assigning zero mass to missing keys before normalization. When only an integer label is supplied, it defines a one-hot target. Training minimizes − ∑ i t i log p i -\sum_{i}t_{i}\log p_{i} averaged over questions within a record, with the ordered-score auxiliary loss disabled.
blocks.zh: 培训包最多可有4,096个令牌,每个州或分行段有2,048个托肯限制;推断服务器允许8,192个令牌并拒绝更长的请求. 目标分布索引选择选项,错误/真实答案,或分数级别,在正常化前给缺失的密钥分配零质量. 当只提供整数标签时,它定义了一热目标. 训练将最小化 – i t我日志 p -\ sum_{i}t_{i}\log p_{i} 平均在一个记录中的问题, 命令分数辅助损失被禁用。

blocks.en: We use TokenRhythm/NeoHorse-1-4B at revision 56f0584b [ 30 ] , with a width-256 readout and zero head dropout. Rank-64 LoRA [ 18 ] uses α = 128 \alpha=128 and dropout 0.05 across attention projections q_proj , k_proj , v_proj , and o_proj ; gated DeltaNet projections in_proj_qkv , in_proj_z , in_proj_a , in_proj_b , and out_proj ; and, for all-module adaptation, feed-forward projections gate_proj , up_proj , and down_proj . The no-FFN configuration omits these last three adapter targets while keeping the pretrained feed-forward modules.

blocks.en: Parameters are stored in FP32 and computation uses BF16 autocast, gradient checkpointing, and gradient clipping at 1.0. AdamW [ 27 ] uses weight decay 0.01, microbatch size one, and accumulation over eight records. The OneCycle schedule [ 37 ] warms up for 10% of updates, begins at one twenty-fifth of the peak learning rate, and cosine-anneals to one ten-thousandth of that initial rate. Its first-moment coefficient cycles inversely between 0.95 and 0.85. Evaluation uses the final weights of each run. The two-epoch runs restart from saved initialization with a two-epoch schedule horizon: 3,864 updates on fold 2 and 3,862 on fold 3.

blocks.en: Within each fold–seed setting, the core learning-rate models start from common saved parameters. The adapter-scope and rank comparisons copy reference parameters wherever their dimensions agree and align the initial CPU/CUDA random-generator states. blocks.en: Training the four learning-rate combinations and the repeated-pointer, trained-residual, and frozen-branch controls across four settings gives 28 models. The adapter-scope and rank comparisons add 20 models while reusing the four reference pointers; eight two-epoch models then reuse those pointers and the four all-module pooling models as their one-epoch references, giving 56 distinct trainings. The joint learning-rate experiments on H100, the additional adapter-scope comparison, and the Qwen3 experiments each use their own references.

blocks.en: For each named comparison, we first subtract scores within a fold–seed setting and then average the four differences. The descriptive standard error is the sample standard deviation of those differences divided by two. All arithmetic uses unrounded values; displayed means may therefore differ by 0.01 percentage points from the displayed paired difference. Factorial main effects average over both levels of the other factor, and interactions combine the corresponding four arms.
blocks.zh: 对于每个命名的比较,我们首先在折叠-种子设置中减去分数,然后平均四个差异。 描述性标准错误是这些差异被除以2的样本标准偏差. 所有算术都使用未四舍五入的值;因此,所显示的手段可能与所显示的对数差异相差0.01个百分点. 因素性主要效应平均在其他因素的这两个层面,相互作用结合了相应的四个臂.

blocks.en: Model development used the primary evaluation suites and fold-development data. Because the four reported settings share six training pools and the same evaluation questions, their standard errors describe variation within this design. The original GPQA few-shot configuration draws demonstrations from the Diamond evaluation population; Appendix B.4 reports a separate evaluation with disjoint demonstrations.

blocks.en: Overlap screening found no exact or normalized state matches between the training corpus and 231 JevBench records or 6,436 Kev record occurrences, using Unicode NFKC normalization, case folding, and whitespace normalization. Available source identities likewise showed no overlap. Further screening covered 30,503 reranking source rows, including 285 MMLU demonstration rows, and the 198-row GPQA file. This coverage is limited to the recorded source text and identities; semantic paraphrases, substrings, pretraining exposure, synthetic chess, and rendered evaluation requests remain unassessed. The intermediate SetFit Amazon conversion has not been recovered.

blocks.en: The saved predictions support independent rescoring of 72 checkpoints: the 56 core NeoHorse models, eight Qwen3 models, and eight higher-rate pointer and pooling checkpoints used in the fixed-interface comparison. Candidate probabilities are stored with answer identities, candidate order, population information, and eligibility rules, allowing predictions and aggregate scores to be recomputed while preserving repeated questions and duplicate answer texts. Some additional learning-rate and adapter-scope results are available only as per-model summaries.

blocks.en: Reproduction requires the base weights, training records, evaluation caches, framework forks, and compatible runtimes specified by the code and configurations. The retained inputs supported reconstruction of the corpus mixture and fold exports, followed by one separate pointer/pooling pair from training through scoring on H20. The OpenCompass and RunWeaver forks are unavailable anonymously, and redistribution permissions for RunWeaver and other assets remain unresolved. The initial source-generation and tokenizer-based eligibility steps remain unreplayed, and the tested environment retains a declared Torch dependency conflict.

blocks.en: CUDA determinism was disabled, allowing repeated training runs to diverge despite matched initial parameters and data streams. Dropout trajectories were not saved for the experiments that varied the head and adapter rates together. Appendix C examines execution variation through repeated-training controls. The 56 core NeoHorse models were trained on individual GPUs of a shared eight-H20 server, using 94.46 GPU hours over the measured training intervals with allocated-memory peaks of 18.32–19.81 GiB. These measurements include concurrent-job contention and diagnostic capture; evaluation and the additional experiments fall outside the timing intervals.

blocks.en: The PIQA state is “Goal: [goal]”, followed by a newline and “Which solution best achieves this goal?”. Direct selection presents both solutions under the instruction “Select the solution that best achieves the goal.”, whereas reranking evaluates each solution in a separate NLI request with the hypothesis “The correct solution is: [solution]”. For the same 1,838 questions, these interfaces require one and two requests per question, respectively.
blocks.zh: PIQA状态是“目标:[目标]”,然后是一行新线,“哪一个解决办法最能实现这一目标?” 直接选择在“选择最能实现目标的解决方案”这一指令下提出了两种解决方案,而用“正确的解决方案是:[解决]”这一假设,在单独的NLI请求中重新评价每一种解决方案。 对于同样的1,838个问题,这些接口分别需要每个问题一个和两个请求.

blocks.en: SocialIQA version 1.4 combines the original context, two newlines, and the question as its state. Direct selection presents the raw A/B/C answer texts under “Select the correct answer to the question.”; NLI reranking places each raw answer in quotation marks within “Hypothesis: [raw answer] How does it relate to the premise?”. Answer fragments remain in their original form, and the three NLI options use the descriptions in Appendix A.1 . Comparing entailment probabilities across answers requires three requests per question, against one for direct selection. All 1,954 questions are evaluated with eight one-epoch checkpoints from the core all-module comparison and eight two-epoch checkpoints from the budget comparison.
blocks.zh: SocialIQA 1.4版本结合了原始上下文,两条新行,问题作为它的状态. 直接选择在“选择对问题的正确答案”下提出原始的A/B/C答案; NLI 重新排序,将每个原始答案用引号放入“Hypothesis:[生答] 这与前提有何关系?” 答案片段仍为原始形式,三种NLI选项使用附录A.1中的描述. 将答案之间的可能性进行比较,每个问题需要三个请求,而直接选择一个请求。 所有1 954个问题都得到评价,8个单一地点的检查站来自核心所有单元的比较,8个两个地点的检查站来自预算的比较。

blocks.en: The SocialIQA source, checkpoint selection, candidate order, request templates, and overlap screening were specified before scoring, after the main evaluations had begun. Exact matching, normalized lexical containment, and available source-lineage checks found no overlap with the training inputs and derivation files, so all questions were retained. These checks address recorded text and provenance; semantic overlap and pretraining exposure remain unmeasured.

blocks.en: To examine sensitivity to the wording of the NLI options, we use the default descriptions in Appendix A.1 and two alternatives. The second set is “The premise supports the hypothesis as true.”, “The premise does not determine whether the hypothesis is true.”, and “The premise supports the hypothesis as false.” The third is “The hypothesis must be true if the premise is true.”, “The hypothesis could be either true or false if the premise is true.”, and “The hypothesis must be false if the premise is true.” For each fixed checkpoint, we cross these descriptions with all six label orders, giving 18 templates while keeping external solution order fixed and retrieving entailment by label identity.
